entries.title: The first mate closes tasks whose work merged another way
entries.body: A task whose pull request was merged as one squashed commit now closes as merged; the first mate keeps the task's own commits as it closes, so nothing is lost. A task whose work merged in another task's pull request, while its own pull request closed unmerged, now closes as done through that other task instead of staying open.
entries.noPicture: The fix is which close the first mate chooses, which shows only as the task leaving the list.
